Based on the provided abstract, the study investigates the synthesis of a polyacrylamide-titanium dioxide (PAA@TiO2) nanocomposite via a cross-linking method to adsorb crystal violet (CV) dye from water, demonstrating a maximum adsorption capacity of 38.9 mg/g and studying molecular interactions via computational simulations. This directly aligns with Hypothesis 3.

CHOICE: 3
